_doc: Checked corrections to the Atlas places, applied by atlas_pack.py on every build (backend/tools/pack_corrections.py). Each text edit makes the field say only what its quoted source says, or drops a claim no source supports. Found in the October 2026 sweep; the source of each is named.

replace: The largest city of Swat and the district capital, on the Swat River.
The largest city of Swat, beside Saidu Sharif, the district capital, on the Swat River.
mingora.why: Saidu Sharif is the district capital (Wikipedia, Saidu Sharif; kanju fact).

replace: The resort was destroyed in June 2008
malam-jabba.why: Wikipedia, Malam Jabba: 'The resort was destroyed by Taliban militants in June 2008'.

replace: its face was damaged by explosives in 2007
its head was damaged by explosives in 2007
jahanabad-buddha.why: Wikipedia: 'In 2007 the Taliban tried to destroy the head of the relief with explosives'.

falak-sar.why: No source says where it is seen from.

replace: Trek from Ushirai Dara (Dir, ~6 h) or Lalko
Trek from Ushirai Dara (Dir) or Lalko
It is at 3,500 m near the Dir-Swat border.
It is near the Dir-Swat border.
saidgai-lake.why: The trek time contradicts sources (7-8 h is also quoted); the fact's quote does not carry the height.

replace: Alpine lake in the Jahaz Banda/Gabeen high country.
Alpine lake listed near Kundol Lake.
gabeen-lake.why: The source (Wikipedia, Kundol Lake) lists 'Gabeen Lake'; nothing places it in Jahaz Banda.

surkar-pass.why: A pass, as its name says (it was filed as a peak).
